description: This file defines the 'virtual' CKEDITOR.eventInfo class, which contains documentation and structure details for the event object passed to event listeners within the CKEditor framework. It includes property definitions and usage examples, serving primarily for documentation purposes.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.eventInfo
classes.description: A conceptual class used to illustrate the properties and structure of the event object passed to event listeners in CKEditor.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Method to indicate that no further event listeners should be called for this event.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Method to cancel the event if it is cancelable.
